**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

- **Preferred position met.** Section 2(a) (p0022) grants a *non-exclusive* licence and goes further, expressly confirming that Client "is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system..." — an affirmative protection of our procurement freedom.
- **No counter-indications.** Section 8 (Client covenants) and Section 5 (compensation) contain no volume commitment, requirements obligation, or sole-source language; minimum monthly fees are a pricing floor, not exclusivity. Section 8(d)'s "nonexclusive" licence runs to TrueLink and Section 12's "solely and exclusively" is forum selection.
- **Noted, not flagged:** Section 3(i) (p0042) requires us to order credit reports from TrueLink for borrowers underwritten *through the Interface*. This is triggered only by our own voluntary use of the Interface and, read with Section 2(a), does not restrict our ability to source elsewhere — an operational tie-in rather than a restrictive covenant.
